caption: Intimate period folk for a lamplit room on a stormy night, watchful and weary. A low cello plays a slow, plain melody from the first bar, with quiet squeezebox chords breathing beneath it. Within a few bars a fiddle answers softly in its low strings, and the two trade short phrases. Midway they come together over the squeezebox, a little fuller, then thin out again; the cello plays its melody once more and comes to rest on a low, quiet chord. A close, roomy recording, warm and woody, played softly.
lyrics:
[Main Theme - slow low cello melody, quiet squeezebox]

[Verse - low fiddle answers the cello]

[Middle - cello, fiddle and squeezebox together, a little fuller]

[Outro - cello melody alone, quiet low chord]

caption: Melancholic period folk, tender and shaken. A wooden flute in its low, breathy range plays a simple old tune from the first bar, slowly, with a low cello moving beneath it. Within a few bars a soft fiddle takes up the same tune and the flute answers it. Midway quiet squeezebox chords gather under them and the tune grows warmer and fuller, close to breaking; then the squeezebox fades and the flute plays the tune one last time, slower, over the cello. A close, roomy recording, warm and woody.
lyrics:
[Main Theme - old tune on low wooden flute, low cello]

[Verse - soft fiddle takes up the tune]

[Middle - squeezebox gathers beneath, warmer and fuller]

[Outro - flute alone with cello, slower]

caption: Dark, restrained folk score, tense and close. A low cello and the bass notes of a squeezebox walk a slow, heavy four-note figure from the first bar, again and again. Within a few bars a fiddle plays short, low, uneasy phrases above it, with silence between them. Midway the figure grows louder and closer as the fiddle tightens into a low tremolo; then it drops back to the cello and squeezebox alone, still walking, unfinished. A dry, close recording in a small dark room.
lyrics:
[Main Theme - slow heavy four-note figure, low cello and squeezebox]

[Verse - short uneasy fiddle phrases above]

[Middle - figure louder, low fiddle tremolo, tightening]

[Outro - cello and squeezebox figure alone, unfinished]

caption: Dark cinematic suspense score, urgent and physical. Low strings drive a fast, insistent pulse from the first second, with a dark cello line over it and a heavy drum on the downbeat. Short string stabs answer the drum, coming closer and closer together, and low brass enters beneath. Midway everything cuts to a single low note and a ticking pulse for a few bars; then drum and strings crash back, louder, and drive to a sudden stop. Tight, dry and close, a film's score.
lyrics:
[Main Theme - fast low string pulse, dark cello, heavy drum]

[Build - string stabs closing in, low brass enters]

[Break - single low note, ticking pulse]

[Climax - drum and strings crash back, louder]

[Outro - sudden stop]

caption: Vast, reverent sacred orchestral music, full of awe. Deep pipe organ chords and a slow harp play a wide, rising melody from the first bars, in warm major harmony. A large, distant wordless choir enters early, soft but clearly heard, singing long open chords beneath the organ. Midway the string orchestra rises with the choir and the whole sound opens out, broad and golden; then it settles back to choir and organ on a long, peaceful final chord. An enormous cathedral, lush and spacious.
lyrics:
[Main Theme - deep organ chords, slow harp, rising melody]

[Choir - large and distant, wordless, clearly heard]
Aah... aah...
Ooh... aah...
Aah... aah...

[Swell - strings rise with the choir, broad and golden]
Aah... ooh... aah...
Aah... aah...
Ooh... aah...

[Outro - choir and organ, long peaceful chord]
Aah...
Aah...

caption: Luminous sacred orchestral music, hopeful and vast. A warm string orchestra and harp climb a slow melody from the first bar, each phrase a step above the last. Within a few bars a soft wordless choir joins them, clearly heard, climbing too. A third of the way through the pipe organ enters, full and warm, and the whole sound opens wide, staying broad and glowing as the choir and strings carry the melody to its height; it closes on a long major chord from choir and organ. An enormous cathedral, lush and spacious.
lyrics:
[Main Theme - warm strings and harp, climbing melody]

[Choir - soft, wordless, clearly heard, climbing]
Ooh... aah...
Ooh... aah...

[Swell - full warm organ enters, everything opens wide]
Aah... aah... aah...
Aah... ooh... aah...

[Outro - choir and organ, long major chord]
Aah...
Aah...

caption: Gentle cinematic folk, bittersweet and close. A felt piano plays a simple, tender melody from the first bar, with an acoustic guitar picking quietly beneath it. Within a few bars a warm cello takes up the melody, low and singing, and the piano answers. Midway soft violins add a quiet harmony and the sound grows fuller and warmer; then the violins leave, and cello and piano play the melody one last time, slower, ending on a gentle chord. An intimate studio recording, soft and airy.
lyrics:
[Main Theme - tender felt piano melody, quiet guitar]

[Verse - warm cello takes up the melody]

[Middle - soft violins join, fuller and warmer]

[Outro - cello and piano, slower, gentle chord]

caption: Warm cinematic folk, tender with a small, surprised smile. An acoustic guitar picks a light, gentle tune from the first bar, with a felt piano answering each phrase. Within a few bars a mellow upright bass walks softly beneath them. Midway a warm cello joins with a slow, singing line and the music glows a little, unhurried; then the cello and bass fall away and guitar and piano finish the tune together, quietly. An intimate studio recording, soft and airy.
lyrics:
[Main Theme - gentle acoustic guitar tune, felt piano answers]

[Verse - mellow upright bass walks beneath]

[Middle - warm cello joins, slow and singing]

[Outro - guitar and piano finish the tune, quiet]
